description: Each quality in every north model, with and without a last good value (ADR-0006).

vectors.description: good (the last read was good), with a last good value: OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
good (the last read was good), with ever_good false (ignored for good): OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
stale (no good read within 3 x the scan rate), with a last good value: OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
stale (no good read within 3 x the scan rate), never read good (no last value): OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
bad_comm (the last attempt failed on the wire), with a last good value: OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
bad_comm (the last attempt failed on the wire), never read good (no last value): OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
bad_decode (the reply could not be converted), with a last good value: OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
bad_decode (the reply could not be converted), never read good (no last value): OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
bad_config (the address is unusable or rejected), with a last good value: OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
bad_config (the address is unusable or rejected), never read good (no last value): OPC UA, OPC DA, Sparkplug and SubDevice JSON.
